mis_merges.label: credit quality stress
subjects: AI-related corporate debt (Oracle/Broadcom CDS) blowing out as ~$500bn of 2026 AI borrowing gets repriced
a methodological debate over true private-credit default rates (1-3% industry measures vs JPM's own ~15% BDC-loan measure)
mis_merges.why: The two halves share no event, instrument, or driver (one is AI-specific public-debt CDS pricing, the other an unrelated private-credit measurement dispute), so burying the private-credit debate under the dominant AI-CDS cards risks the editor never surfacing it as its own brief.

notes: misc correctly holds 12 of 1619 cards (0.7%) as pure market-wrap overflow. The AI-debt-financing fact pattern (Broadcom/OpenAI/Anthropic, Oracle, SpaceX) also recurs loosely across 'sovereign capital crowding out', 'credit quality stress' and 'ai chip capacity buildout'; only the clearest, most consequential split is scored as a mis-merge.
